scope.fixture_source: saved CLEF discovery states; not held-out gameplay
scope.claim: Native interface, BF16 wrapper parity, repeatability and in-memory quantization compatibility on the listed fixtures

runtime.backend: native MLX text backbone; original PyTorch CPU FP32 pointer head
runtime.resolver: exact pinned local snapshot resolution; unknown identifiers refused without fallback
runtime.adapter_transport: in-process callback through the adapter; no live HTTP server or HTTP transport tested

fixture_provenance.selection: BF16 discovery rounds 1,5,10,15; first, floor(n/2)+1, and final attempt, preserving that order.

prior_attempts.reason: Pinned source clean-check refused packaging artifacts
Native snapshot lookup requested repository metadata and offline mode refused it

budget_accounting.method: Ceiling of original supervisor start through continuation final exit, including gap; plus retry receipt start through final supervisor exit. The old worker durations are not summed.

memory_and_storage.note: RSS and MLX metrics overlap in unified memory; do not add them. Storage is a post-run file-byte observation and can grow with later evidence.

quantization.baseline: separate fresh native FP32 LoRA merge rounded once to BF16 before each condition

probability_note: Unrounded FP32 native softmax values; choices use native argmax before four-decimal HTTP serialization. Logits include the unchanged native temperature.

raw_evidence.path_base: approved experiment storage root (local; location omitted from public extract)
raw_evidence.retention: Full raw journals retained locally; this report is an allowlisted extract, not a replacement for them.
